items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued November 20 at 1:23AM EST until November 22 at 4:00AM EST by NWS Wilmington NC
items.description:
* WHAT...Northeast winds 20 to 30 kt and seas 6 to 9 ft expected.

* WHERE...Southeast North Carolina coastal waters out 20 NM.

* WHEN...Until 4 AM EST Sunday.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
